scope: Offline JSDOM controller behavior and generated-graph schema checks using the current runtime catalog. The small baseline observation fixture is synthetic. When actual_job_sha256 is present, an additional inspector check consumes that successful runtime job receipt without rerunning its tensor computation. Real browser rendering, pointer behavior and actual tensor computation require separate qualification.
checks: Actual component catalog enables the visual builder and searchable block library
Expanded Llama graph has valid catalog ports, parameters, DAG topology and nonoverlapping node footprints
Multiple decoder layers keep independent weights and preserve all residual and rotary connections
Fused SwiGLU and custom activation produce actual alternative connected operations
Invalid head geometry, dimensions, learning rates, corpus and parameter budgets retain clear validation errors
Vocabulary expansion safely sizes the embedding and LM head for additional plain-text training sentences
Visual builder shows component branches and validates geometry without creating or queuing a workflow
Corrected builder inputs clear stale submission errors and reenable creation without any invalid mutation
Custom activation is optional, remains editable, and creates a complete connected training workflow
Executed tensor-graph reports render all real expression operations with shape and tensor details
Actual successful execution receipt drives every operation, tensor, shape, source connection and custom-code inspector
Visual execution entry point selects the requested actual model job and rejects unavailable or non-Transformers jobs without mutations
Unavailable component catalog disables entry points and unexpected controller errors are absent
